detail.title: WAKE Architectural Model and Governance Self-Study
detail.summary: WAKE implements a 'Governance-as-Code' model, separating proposal generation (AI actor) from validation (Governance layer). The AI acts as an untrusted proposal engine, while the Governance layer serves as the immutable state manager, mirroring principles of secure, deterministic systems design. This structure ensures that no matter how complex the AI reasoning becomes, it cannot circumvent the underlying validation rules defined for research integrity and state updates.
detail.reason: The architecture is fundamental to WAKE's operation and explains how it maintains consistency across cycles.

detail.title: Provisional Foundations of WAKE Durable Record
detail.summary: WAKE models operational state through a deterministic replay of accepted events, ensuring that current state is never cached but derived from an authoritative, append-only SQLite log. Governance acts as the sole validator for proposals, preventing invalid states from entering the durable chain.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate governance and record store roles in operational state modeling.

detail.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
detail.summary: WAKE✳︎ ensures accountability by delegating authority to a deterministic governance module that rejects unauthorized proposal transitions, while the research layer provides structured, bounded access to external evidence, preventing the system from bypassing its own constraints.
